tagline: Different location every month. Same family every time.

hero.label: Different location every month
hero.headline: Your people are out here.
hero.text: A monthly gathering for nomads. Music, play, wellness and connection, somewhere new every month.

about.headline: Strangers become family.
about.text: LSSQ pops up somewhere new each month: a desert lot, a mountain forest, the Baja coast. Everyone brings their own gifts and talents to share, and the four pillars do the rest.

pillars.name: Wellness
pillars.text: Morning yoga, sound baths and slow coffee.

pillars.name: Play
pillars.text: Games, side quests and whatever someone dreams up.

pillars.name: Music
pillars.text: Jams, DJ sets and songs around the fire.

pillars.name: Connection
pillars.text: Strangers on Friday, family by Sunday.

story.headline: It started with one Saturday.
story.text: LSSQ began as single-day meetups on the last Saturday of the month, somewhere new each time. People kept asking for more, so it grew into weekend-long gatherings, shaped by the people who show up.
story.photoAlt: A pink and orange sunset over a dirt lot of vans, trucks and tents, with wooded hills behind.

chapters.title: One Saturday a month
chapters.text: The idea was simple: pick a spot, roll in on the last Saturday of the month and meet your people. A new place every time, from desert lots to mountain forests to the Baja coast.
chapters.photoAlt: A crowd of smiling people squeezed into a selfie on a grassy field, arms in the air.

chapters.title: Then whole weekends
chapters.text: One day was never enough. The meetups grew into weekends, with time to settle in on Friday, be together all Saturday and pack up slowly on Sunday.
chapters.photoAlt: A big group in bright costumes and wigs grinning for a photo outdoors under a grey sky.

chapters.title: Everyone brings something
chapters.text: There's no lineup. People share their own gifts and talents: a yoga class, a jam, a meal for everyone. Wellness, play, music and connection hold it all together.
chapters.photoAlt: A hand playing guitar by a campfire at night.
chapters.photoCredit: Stock photo by Vitaly Gariev, Unsplash

chapters.title: Kept going by the family
chapters.text: LSSQ runs almost entirely on donations. Every bit covers the land, the power and the little things that make a weekend feel like home.
chapters.photoAlt: People doing yoga on a beach at sunset, in silhouette against the sea.
chapters.photoCredit: Stock photo by Tomi Saputra, Unsplash

donate.headline: Keep the quest going.
donate.text: LSSQ runs almost entirely on donations. Every bit helps cover the land, the power and the little things that make a weekend.

contact.headline: Say hi.
contact.text: Questions about an event, or want to share a gift or talent at the next one? The quickest way to reach us is a message on Instagram.
